entries.claim: fmt, check-sql, host + wasm32 clippy -D warnings, boundaries 25/25, duet-health, duet-client, and duet-app unit suites pass at clean HEAD
entries.label: gates-and-units
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo fmt --all --check
python3 scripts/check-sql.py
python3 -m unittest scripts/test_check_sql.py scripts/test_ci_scenarios.py
cargo clippy --locked -p duet-health -p duet-client -p duet-api -p duet-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --locked -p duet-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --bins -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked -p boundaries
cargo test --locked -p duet-health
cargo test --locked -p duet-client
cargo test --locked -p duet-app --lib
